newsitem.title: CANADA: Norcen gets last payment from iron ore sale.
newsitem.headline: Norcen gets last payment from iron ore sale.

text.p: Norcen Energy Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it received a final installment of C$120 million from the sale last year of its stake in Iron Ore Co of Canada to the Labrador Iron Ore Royalty Income Fund.
A portion of the proceeds was used to pay down Norcen's debt, bringing the current level to C$460.1 million, net of cash, it said.

The debt level is less than one year's cash flow from operations, Norcen said. It said the remaining funds were invested in short-term facilities and would be deployed over time in its oil and gas business.
